Moving the Power slider, clicking an entry, composer insertion and Send are first exercised by the next queued request, so this outcome stays unverified.

required_outcomes.observable: On SECONDARY the open automation-window replacement commits through the central coordinator, the read-only doctor reports ready, and the relay lock stays held by the persistent service.
A real provider send goes through the relay after the install: the ledger gains a new submission after 2026-09-24T19:48:57Z with exact controls verified and no duplicate or ambiguous submission.
required_outcomes.live_note: Not yet possible: all 13 requests the relay can see expired (newest queued 2026-09-24T15:50:39Z), so nothing is eligible to send until a worker queues a new supervision request.

required_outcomes.observable: The SECONDARY lease is extended by a same-identity renewal (only expiresAt changes) before or after its 2026-09-27T00:00Z expiry, and the central scheduler reports ACTIVE_LEASE.
required_outcomes.live_note: Owner-run renewal to 2026-10-27T00:00:00.000Z: same lease identity, only expiresAt changes, automatic rollback. A committed window replacement or a ready doctor does not prove a send; only a new ledger submission does.
An installed tree hash does not prove the running relay loaded it.
